title: 第二章阴风谷
slug: 开局阴阳宗从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

场地内人数不多，张守安简单扫了一眼，大概有六七个人。

此时一阵安静，看起来倒是有些压抑，张守安看向一旁的男子，就看见了对方脸上流下的汗珠。

看起来是有些紧张。

张守安自然理解对方的心情，他此刻也有同样的心理。

若是分配到一个根本完不成的任务，那怎么办。

就在他思考时，郑雅回来了，她走到几人的最前方，取出几枚任务玉简，清了下嗓子：

“现在开始分发任务。”

“乙等下级任务：巡视宗门北面矿场。奖励30灵石。”

“乙等下级任务：去后山清风亭，给守阵师兄送信，奖励30灵石。”

她刚说罢，便有一个满脸肥肉的弟子打断了她的话语：

“师姐，我去送信！我去！”

郑雅的眉目不自觉地皱了一下，但脸上还维持着笑容，不理这人：

“乙等……”

她继续说了大概四五条，都是乙等下级的任务，其中有个任务是清理万兽窟，郑雅自作主张分给了刚才插话的那人。

张守安本来没听出什么不对，却听一旁的人小声解释：

“这个任务是乙等下级任务里最难的，据说要清理妖兽的粪便，还要防着妖兽的袭击。”

张守安看向刚才插话的那人，只见他的脸色早已变得苍白，身体无力地瘫倒在了椅背之上。

不过张守安倒是一阵可惜，自己现在就是需要这种任务，来赚道行值，你怎么还不高兴啊。

最后，郑雅面露难色地取出一枚深色玉简：

“还有个任务。”

她先是无言，最后才慢慢说出：

“乙等中级任务，猎杀一头在阴风谷出没的受伤黑风狼。”

“这畜生伤了门内好几人，虽已受伤，但仍有练气初期的实力。诸位，谁愿接下？奖励100灵石。”

广场上瞬间安静下来。几个刚才还兴致勃勃的弟子，此刻都缩了缩脖子。

练气初期的妖兽？开什么玩笑，那可是会要命的。

对于张守安他们这些修士来说，自己和同等境界的妖物，完全就不是一个水平。

妖物的力气，防御，还有机动性，都是同境界的人类比不上的存在。

所以，一般都是派练气中期的修士，来对付初期的妖物。

但好在，这是一个受伤的妖兽。

Page (1/3)

There were not many people in the venue. Zhang Shouan took a quick glance and found that there were about six or seven people.

There was a moment of silence, which seemed a bit depressing. Zhang Shou'an looked at the man beside him and saw beads of sweat streaming down his face.

He looked a little nervous.

Zhang Shouan naturally understood the other party's mood, and he had the same mentality at the moment.

What should I do if I am assigned a task that cannot be completed at all?

Just as he was thinking, Zheng Ya came back. She walked to the front of the group, took out a few mission jade slips, and cleared her throat:

"Start distributing tasks now."

"B-level lower-level mission: inspect the mine north of the sect. Reward 30 spirit stones."

"B-level lower-level mission: Go to Qingfeng Pavilion in the back mountain and deliver a message to the guarding brother. Reward 30 spirit stones."

As soon as she finished speaking, a fat disciple interrupted her:

"Sister, I'm going to deliver the letter! I'm going!"

Zheng Ya frowned unconsciously, but she still maintained a smile on her face and ignored this person:

"Class B..."

She went on to talk about about four or five tasks, all of which were tasks for second-level subordinates. One of them was to clean up the cave of beasts. Zheng Ya took it upon herself to assign it to the person who just interrupted.

Zhang Shou'an didn't hear anything wrong at first, but he heard someone on the side explain in a low voice:

"This task is the most difficult among the B-level lower-level tasks. It is said that you have to clean up the feces of monsters and guard against attacks by monsters."

Zhang Shouan looked at the person who had just interrupted, and saw that his face had already turned pale, and his body slumped weakly on the back of the chair.

However, Zhang Shou'an felt a pity. He needs this kind of task now to earn Taoist points. Why are you still not happy?

Finally, Zheng Ya took out a dark jade slip with a look of embarrassment on her face:

"There is another mission."

She was speechless at first, then slowly said:

"B-level intermediate mission, hunt down an injured black wind wolf that haunts the Shadow Wind Valley."

"This beast has injured several people in the door. Although it has been injured, it still has the strength of the early stage of Qi training. Everyone, who is willing to take it? The reward is 100 spirit stones."

The square fell silent for an instant.Several disciples who were in high spirits just now shrank their necks.

A monster in the early stages of Qi training?Are you kidding, that could kill you.

For monks like Zhang Shou'an, they are not at the same level as monsters of the same level.

The monster's strength, defense, and mobility are all unmatched by humans in the same realm.

Therefore, monks in the middle stage of Qi training are usually sent to deal with monsters in the early stage.

But fortunately, this is a wounded monster.
